d:
Anu and I spent 3 days and 2 nights aboard the Genesis Regal Cruise in Vietnam, exploring the stunning Halong Bay and Lan Ha Bay. For two nights, this boat was our home, surrounded by beautiful limestone islands and endless views.
Our journey started at Tuan Chau Marina, followed by Dark & Bright Cave, Viet Hai Village on Cat Ba Island, Ba Trai Dao (Three Peaches Beach) and Tra Bau, where we also enjoyed kayaking between the islands.
One of our favourite parts was the dining experience on board, enjoying lovely meals together with the most beautiful views.
